body:
## What this listing is

Welcome Pickups is a service where you book a local driver in advance. Its Lisbon page is built around the airport pickup, and adds paid extras such as sightseeing rides and day trips that you book with the same driver. You pay the partner when you book; this page only describes what the listing shows.

## What the pickup includes

The page lists four things with the airport pickup: local English-speaking drivers, a flat pre-paid fee that it says is equivalent to a taxi from the rank, flight monitoring for delays, and 24/7 customer support with flexible cancellation. It also says you can pre-order SIM cards and Wi-Fi hotspots, skip-the-line tickets and local souvenir boxes after you book.

## Services and prices shown

On 8 October 2026 the Lisbon page showed these services:

- Chauffeur service with a local driver: 42€ per hour
- Additional hour of sightseeing: 55€ up to 8 people
- Private airport transfer with a 1-hour highlights ride: 80€ up to 8 people
- The Best of Lisbon in 2 hours (6 stops): 99€ up to 8 people
- Lisbon by Night tour: 155€ up to 8 people
- Half-day sightseeing (6 stops): 180€ up to 8 people
- Live fado show and traditional dinner with a night tour: 180€ up to 8 people
- Day trip to Sintra and Cascais: 270€ up to 8 people

Longer private trips on the page include Fátima, Nazaré and Óbidos, and Évora. Prices are in euros as the page states them, and most are per vehicle for up to eight people, so a group splits the cost. A chauffeur hour is charged per hour.

## How to read the prices

The airport pickup itself did not show a fixed price on the page we read; it is quoted after you enter passengers and luggage in the booking form for Lisbon Airport. Compare the quote with a taxi and with the airport train, since the listing itself points to the taxi fare as the benchmark.

## When it fits

It suits arriving late, travelling with children or heavy bags, or turning the ride into a short first look at Lisbon with the same driver. If you land early and have only a backpack, public transport may be simpler.
